scope: One fixed complete native CPU task on the observed shared host; no isolated-hardware, selector or general workload claim
environmentPolicy: Observe unchanged CPU/cgroup/SMT telemetry and quiet qualification labels. Include all 72 processes regardless of background activity; never trim, replace, or subtract interference. Numerical/output failures still stop the experiment. Uncertainty is conditional on this shared-host session and is not hardware isolation evidence.
cpuSelection: Reuse CPU 96, previously fixed from a 30-second idle observation before task timings; same affinity and one OpenMP thread for all arms.
cachePolicy: Normal warmed executable/filesystem pages; no cache purge; independent native process and fresh output directory per task; cyclic positions are balanced twice.
inference: Paired bootstrap of ratio of arithmetic mean complete-task latencies; six primary comparisons use Bonferroni-adjusted two-sided intervals. Five-percent baseline half-to-half drift gate limits claims from this session. Report every comparator, even when a candidate fails the stricter all-comparators flag. Matching or trailing LLAMA does not erase a demonstrated benefit over conventional AoS.
historicalBoundary: Separate complete cohort after the quiet-only attempt stopped at a preflight following four processes. Those four results are excluded wholesale; no case, binary, candidate or layout was selected using their timings. This amendment changes the environmental question to observed shared-host performance. Earlier failed discovery remains failed.
stop: One complete cohort, 15-minute child deadline and 1 GiB output budget plus 10 GiB disk reserve; no rerun or further project automatically follows.
